title: platform-objects: the sys_trusted_key docblock names verifyPluginArtifact as install's verifier and calls the shipped boot-time loader unbuilt
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ①: a docblock that names the wrong verifier and calls a shipped loader unbuilt, with named locations. Found by the contract review of PR #27815 (#27684, ADR-0025 v2 text), record 6512098408 on head `c49a117f`, follow-up 5. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. Filed without `domain:*`: the fix is in `packages/platform-objects`; triage sets the lane.

Business reason: `sys_trusted_key` is the store an author or an AI reads to learn how plugin signatures are checked. Its docblock sends a reader to the wrong function and says the boot-time check does not exist yet, so someone tracing why a boot refused a plugin starts from a false picture.
Reader who acts: the lane triage assigns. One os-dev, one docblock edit, no behaviour change.
Dedupe: issues searched for `sys-trusted-key docblock verifyPluginArtifact` → no card.

## Measured (read from source on `main` `fec60e00b`, not run live)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-trusted-key.object.ts:12` says install verifies the artifact bytes with `verifyPluginArtifact`. `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/install.ts` imports and calls `verifyPublisherSignature` (`:65`, `:259`); `verifyPluginArtifact` wraps it.
- `:41` says the readers are the install command "and ADR-0025 M1's boot-time loader in the runtime once it is built". That loader is built (#27374; `packages/runtime/src/installed-plugin-loader.ts` resolves the same key id and refuses `signature_key_untrusted` / `signature_key_revoked`).

## Wanted

- `:12` names `verifyPublisherSignature` (or names both, with which one install calls).
- `:41` names the boot-time loader as a current reader, `packages/runtime/src/installed-plugin-loader.ts`.

## Acceptance

- Both lines match the tree; no code change; `skip-changeset` unless the package's changeset rules say a docblock needs one.
